title: Exam Technique and Final Review

header.html: Review across security, compliance and identity concepts; Microsoft Entra; Microsoft security solutions; Microsoft compliance solutions
the official SC-900 study guide, skills measured as of October 21, 2026

html:
1Exam technique

  • Read the last line first (what is asked), then the scenario.
  • Find the keyword: "if-then at sign-in" = Conditional Access; "just in time" = PIM; "shadow IT" = Defender for Cloud Apps.
  • Eliminate products from the wrong family (a firewall does not label documents).
  • Two similar answers? Ask: identity, network, threat, data or compliance?
  • Interactive items: drag-and-drop and match lists use the same facts as multiple choice.
  • Manage time: 45 minutes; do not stay on one item; mark and return.
  • You need 700 of 1,000 to pass; unanswered items count as wrong, so always answer.

2Product-to-job map

If the question says... Think
Sign in, passwords, MFA Microsoft Entra ID, authentication
If-then rules at sign-in Conditional Access
Admin only when needed PIM
Risky sign-in or user Entra ID Protection
Periodic recertification Access reviews
Floods of traffic Azure DDoS Protection
SQL injection, XSS Web Application Firewall
RDP without public IP Azure Bastion
Secrets, keys, certificates Key Vault
Posture, secure score, recommendations Defender for Cloud
SIEM and SOAR Microsoft Sentinel
Email links and attachments Defender for Office 365
Devices, EDR Defender for Endpoint
On-premises AD attacks Defender for Identity
Shadow IT, CASB Defender for Cloud Apps
Microsoft's audit reports Service Trust Portal
Personal data, subject requests Priva
Regulatory assessment, compliance score Compliance Manager
Tags that encrypt and mark files Sensitivity labels
Stop data leaving DLP
Keep or delete by time Retention
Legal case search and hold eDiscovery
Who did what Audit
Departing employee exfiltration Insider Risk Management

3Easily confused pairs

Pair Difference
Secure score vs compliance score Posture (Defender) vs regulatory improvement actions (Purview)
Entra roles vs Azure RBAC Identity resources vs Azure resources
Sign-in risk vs user risk This login vs this account
NSG vs Azure Firewall Simple rules per subnet vs central managed firewall
Content explorer vs activity explorer What and where vs what happened
Retention policy vs label Broad vs per item
Defender XDR vs Defender for Cloud Workplace threat protection vs cloud workload posture and protection
Information barriers vs communication compliance Prevent contact vs review messages

4Exam Q&A: final review

4.1 Mixed questions (choose the best answer)

S1Fabrikam Outdoors wants administrators to hold roles only when needed, with approval and MFA at activation. Which tool?

  • AAccess reviews of group membership
  • BSmart lockout after repeated failures
  • CEntra Connect for directory synchronization
  • DPrivileged Identity Management
Show the answer

Answer: D. PIM provides just-in-time role activation with approval and MFA.

S2A company wants a score of its Azure configuration against recommendations. Which tool?

  • APurview compliance score for regulations
  • BDefender for Cloud secure score
  • CSentinel workbook of log dashboards
  • DAzure Firewall for network filtering
Show the answer

Answer: B. Secure score in Defender for Cloud measures posture.

S3Which Zero Trust principle says to grant the minimum access needed?

  • AAssume breach and limit the blast radius
  • BVerify explicitly using all available signals
  • CUse least privilege access
  • DTrust the network inside the office
Show the answer

Answer: C. Least privilege limits access to what is necessary.

S4Who is responsible for the data and identities of a customer in Azure SaaS?

  • AMicrosoft only
  • BThe customer
  • CThe ISP
  • DNobody
Show the answer

Answer: B. Data, endpoints, accounts and access are always the customer's responsibility.

S5An analyst wants to automate a response to a Sentinel incident. What should be used?

  • AA workbook
  • BA playbook
  • CA bookmark
  • DA label
Show the answer

Answer: B. Playbooks automate response.

S6A user's sign-in originates in two countries within an hour. Which service flags it?

  • AEntra ID Protection
  • BAzure Bastion
  • CKey Vault
  • DDLP
Show the answer

Answer: A. Impossible travel is a sign-in risk detection.

S7Which feature requires MFA only when users sign in from untrusted locations?

  • ASecurity defaults
  • BSelf-service password reset
  • CFederation
  • DConditional Access
Show the answer

Answer: D. Conditional Access applies if-then rules based on signals.

S8Which solution applies encryption and a watermark to a document marked Confidential?

  • ARetention label
  • BNSG
  • CSafe Links
  • DSensitivity label
Show the answer

Answer: D. Sensitivity labels encrypt and mark content.

S9Which solution produces a searchable record of administrator actions in Microsoft 365?

  • ADefender for Endpoint for device threats
  • BCompliance Manager assessments
  • CMicrosoft Purview Audit
  • DAzure Firewall for network filtering
Show the answer

Answer: C. Audit logs user and admin activity.

S10A company wants to prevent files with credit card numbers from being uploaded to external sharing. Which fits?

  • AAccess reviews
  • BAzure DDoS Protection
  • CTrainable classifiers only
  • DDLP
Show the answer

Answer: D. DLP monitors and blocks sensitive data from leaving.

S11An engineer wants to store a database connection string without placing it in code. What fits?

  • AAzure Bastion
  • BAn NSG
  • CAzure Key Vault
  • DPriva
Show the answer

Answer: C. Key Vault stores secrets securely.

S12Where can a company get Microsoft's ISO 27001 audit report?

  • ADefender portal
  • BService Trust Portal
  • CEntra admin center
  • DAzure Monitor
Show the answer

Answer: B. The Service Trust Portal hosts audit reports.

4.2 Rapid recall

R1What is the default Defender for Cloud standard?

Show the answer

The Microsoft cloud security benchmark.

R2What is Microsoft Entra ID's previous name?

Show the answer

Azure Active Directory.

R3Pass score for SC-900?

Show the answer

700 out of 1,000.

R4What does SOAR do?

Show the answer

Automates incident response.

R5What is the difference between eligible and active in PIM?

Show the answer

Eligible can activate; active has the role now.

R6Name the three Zero Trust principles.

Show the answer

Verify explicitly, use least privilege access and assume breach.

5Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Technique read the question, find the keyword, eliminate, answer everything, manage 45 minutes
Pass 700 of 1,000
Domains concepts 10–15%, Entra 25–30%, security solutions 35–40%, compliance 20–25%
